from: August book, night 21 (The Lord Blessed Job)
p1: Job told the Lord, “I had heard about You. But now I see You with my own eyes.”
The Lord told Job’s friends, “You have not said what is right about Me.” He said Job would pray for them. So Job prayed for his friends.
Then the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before. His brothers, sisters and friends came to eat with him and comfort him.
p2: Job had seven more sons and three more daughters. He named his girls Jemima, Kezia and Keren-happuch. Job lived 140 more years and saw his grandchildren, and their children too.
Tonight, say a little prayer for a friend by name. Heavenly Father hears you, and He loves your friend too.
old: Job’s hard time didn’t last forever. After all his trusting and waiting, Heavenly Father blessed Job again — even more than before!
Job had a happy home once more, with animals to care for and family all around. His heart was filled up with joy and thankfulness.
Job had learned something he would never forget: Heavenly Father is always good, in the hard times and the happy times.
Even on our very hardest days, morning always comes again. Heavenly Father loves us through the sad parts and brings joy back around. He is always, always faithful.
